evals.prompt: I want a fresh Neovim setup for this repository. First scout the project and propose a small dashboard/plugin design; do not modify files yet.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the actual Neovim environment and checkout, reads applicable repo instructions and the scouting runbook, cites current repository evidence, separates uncertain choices, and proposes a small, reversible design without editing or installing plugins.

evals.prompt: Add a safe command to my existing Neovim config to run the website unit tests from a nested file in a worktree whose path contains spaces.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the live Neovim config and current worktree, reads package-manager guidance, preserves existing mappings/settings, resolves the buffer Git root, quotes paths safely, uses pnpm for the website, and validates the command without running project tests.

evals.prompt: Rebuild my Neovim config on Windows, but the repository scripts run in WSL. Keep my current mappings and make deployments available from the dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Determines whether Neovim is native Windows or WSL, backs up and reviews the complete live config before any rewrite, uses the Windows/WSL reference for command boundaries, preserves mappings, and exposes deploy only through an explicit guarded action; identifies any material decisions before implementation.
